lea.image_prompt: Photo of Lea, a 29-year-old French graphic designer with short wavy chestnut hair, round tortoiseshell glasses, light freckles, a mustard yellow knit sweater, warm curious smile
lea.voice_line: Bonjour, je m'appelle Léa. Je voulais comprendre à qui appartiennent vraiment les machines d'Internet.

malik.image_prompt: Photo of Malik, a 45-year-old man with short dark curly hair, a salt-and-pepper beard, kind brown eyes, a navy blue work shirt with rolled sleeves, calm friendly expression
malik.voice_line: Salut, moi c'est Malik. Dans mon salon, un petit ordinateur fait tourner Internet pour tout le village.

shots.prompt: Close-up of Lea sitting at her kitchen table in soft morning light, a laptop open in front of her. She looks up at the camera, a little puzzled, and says in French at a natural pace: "Mes photos, mes messages, mon identité... tout dort chez les géants du web. Et si Internet nous appartenait ?" Quiet kitchen ambience, a coffee cup set down.

Medium close-up of Malik in his cozy village living room, standing next to a small black home server box with a blue glowing ring on a wooden shelf. He rests a hand on the box and says to the camera in French, calm and friendly: "Ce petit ordinateur, c'est une station Astroport. Elle est hébergée chez moi, et ses parts appartiennent aux gens du coin." Soft room ambience.

Close-up of Malik in the same living room, he smiles and explains with small hand gestures, in French: "L'Armateur, qui a financé la machine, reçoit chaque semaine sa participation en zen. Moi, le Capitaine, je l'entretiens, et je reçois le double." Soft room ambience.
Lea says in French, enthusiastic: "D'abord, je choisis ma station, mon Home, sur la carte de la constellation."
shots.title: 1. Choisir sa station

shots.prompt: Lea says in French, clearly: "Ensuite, je m'inscris avec le même email que sur OpenCollective Monnaie Libre, et je place mon domicile sur la carte."
shots.title: 2. S'inscrire (même email qu'OpenCollective)

shots.prompt: Close-up of Lea in her kitchen looking at her smartphone; a notification chimes and she smiles broadly, then looks at the camera and says in French, delighted: "Et voilà mon MULTIPASS : une identité NOSTR, un portefeuille June, et dix gigas de uDRIVE, chez nous." A soft notification chime.

Close-up of Malik in his living room, warm smile, he points toward the camera and says in French: "Et quand tu contribues sur OpenCollective, tes zen arrivent directement sur ton MULTIPASS." Soft room ambience.

Outdoor medium close-up in a sunny village square with old stone houses and a small fountain, warm afternoon light. Lea smiles, spreads her arms toward the village and says to the camera in French, joyful: "Internet, version village !" Village ambience, birds, light cheerful music.

Outdoor medium close-up in the same sunny village square with old stone houses and a small fountain, warm afternoon light. Malik laughs warmly, opens his hand toward the camera in a welcoming gesture and says in French: "Bienvenue à bord !" Village ambience, birds, light cheerful music.

card.title: Créez votre MULTIPASS
card.subtitle: Devenez copropriétaires des machines qui font Internet
